verdicts.reason: In both, the original's warm orange-tinted photo has turned into a dark photo with a hard-edged orange block on top. In both, the white frame sits empty on the left while the 'RICHMOND HIGH SCHOOL THEATRE PRESENTS' text is squeezed into a narrow column beside it. Both also blow the small play-arrow icon up into a huge element that competes with the headline. A at least keeps 'Pygmalion' clear of the frame. In B, 'Pygmalion' runs across the frame's right edge, and the ticket text sits jammed against the right edge of the canvas, so B is slightly worse.
